data.content_ref: inline:Make edge construction itself a second least fixpoint: formalize warrant-carriage → attack-edge materialization (including the closure rule) as a monotone operator on the finite edge lattice, and compute its least fixpoint before Pass 1. The composition of two least fixpoints on finite lattices is deterministic and polynomial; reinstatement remains a derived property inside Pass 1; committed roots stay valid provided the edge operator is root-preserving — it only materializes edges already carried by registered warrants and never invents acceptance. This moves the skeptical guarantees down to the place the spec names as the real locus of the question, making edge provenance auditable as a fixpoint in its own right and exposing where monotonicity could silently break.
